title: phit-polyfill
tagline: phit's models and distributions in pure PHP, identical bit for bit to the extension on every tested input.
summary: phit-polyfill defines phit's functions in the Phit namespace when the native extension is not loaded. It ports phit's Rust code to PHP, so regression and mixed-model fits, distribution functions, samplers, and descriptive statistics return the same bits as the extension on every tested input, with the same parameter names, result keys, warnings, and exception codes. Code written against phit runs unchanged on hosts where the extension cannot be installed. Where the extension is installed, the polyfill defines nothing and phit is used.
requires: No extensions; the phit extension is used instead when it is loaded
